summary: Retain OMP restart-test child stderr and exit diagnostics in failure artifacts.

replay.detail: No replay or backfill. Only isolated test diagnostics change.

schema.detail: No stored schema, checkpoint or digest format changes.

rules.detail: No production or admission rule changes. The restart test keeps its liveness and empty-stderr assertions; failed guardian cleanup now retains the actual channel stderr and any exit status observed by the test.

compatibility.detail: No CLI, client, wire or declaration format changes.

downtime.detail: No running service or seat is changed by this test diagnostic correction.

manual.detail: No operator action is required. The original OMP premature-exit cause remains under investigation.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes. Ordinary source rollback restores the prior test diagnostics.
